rationale: With only 19 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: price is sitting at 91.7% of today's range near the session high with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, indecisive oscillation between $42.06–$42.15 and no clear directional momentum.
